Smart Quality Test System

Your strongest technical story
1. The 60-second overview

Problem → users → inputs → key processing stages → output → measured result. End with your exact contribution.

2. Architecture and data flow

Be ready to draw the major components, their interfaces, storage, external services, and failure paths. Explain why each boundary exists.

3. Technology and metric choices

Define every result precisely. Explain why you chose the stack, how you evaluated it, and which failure cases remain.

4. Engineering trade-offs

Discuss performance, reliability, complexity, cost, maintainability, security, and the alternatives you considered.

5. Ownership and teamwork

Separate your contribution from the team's work. Describe one decision, one blocker, and how the final system was verified.

6. What you would improve

Propose the next change to architecture, testing, monitoring, deployment, or user feedback—without pretending it already existed.
